situations.when: I have a new idea or feature
I'm ready to write it down as a change
the plan is done and I want to build
the change is big or risky
the kit itself got in my way

tools.name: openspec
tools.reason: Spec-driven change workflow (explore, proposal, specs, design, tasks, apply, archive); the kit's default workflow

rubric.problem_fit: Structured, reviewable planning that lives in the repo
rubric.overlap: SuperSpec and Superpowers claim the same phases; resolved on their entries
rubric.run_cost: Free CLI; only Claude usage while working

verdicts.rationale: In use for this repo's planning
A/B trial - same result as SuperSpec at about 1/4 of the time and 1/5 of the cost; default workflow

tools.name: superspec
tools.reason: OpenSpec schema that wires in Superpowers (worktree, subagent TDD, verify) for big or risky changes

install.win32: copy openspec/schemas/superspec from the repo, then openspec init --tools claude --profile custom with XDG_CONFIG_HOME redirected (project-only; see evals/trials/workflow-ab-setup.md)

rubric.problem_fit: Strong process (isolation, audit trail, verify report), asks instead of guessing
rubric.overlap: Same phases as OpenSpec spec-driven; used per change, never as the default
rubric.context_cost: High; 165 requests and 13 subagents for a small change
rubric.run_cost: About 5x plain OpenSpec on the trial task
rubric.reversibility: Remove openspec/schemas/superspec and switch the change schema back

verdicts.rationale: A/B trial - equal result, about 4x the time and 5x the cost on a small, tightly specified change; re-test on a big or risky one

tools.name: superpowers
tools.reason: Brainstorming, plan writing and subagent TDD; the build engine behind SuperSpec

rubric.overlap: Planning skills overlap OpenSpec; used only through SuperSpec
rubric.context_cost: Medium; session-start hook and many skills
rubric.run_cost: Uses Claude quota; subagents add requests
rubric.trust: Widely used; past Windows hook bugs, none seen here

verdicts.rationale: Windows smoke test passed (start, input, skills, per-project scoping); value shown in the SuperSpec build phase

tools.name: gitleaks
tools.reason: Blocks commits that contain secrets; needed because the kit repo is public

rubric.problem_fit: Catches tokens and keys before they reach a public repo
rubric.overlap: The feedback skill's text scrub covers a different case (text, not commits)
rubric.context_cost: None; runs as a git hook outside Claude

verdicts.rationale: Hook blocked a fake token and passed clean commits; full history scan found no leaks

tools.name: playwright-cli
tools.reason: Browser checks for web UI projects (verify phase)

rubric.problem_fit: Lets the agent check real pages
rubric.overlap: Possible overlap with Claude in Chrome; unverified

verdicts.rationale: Not needed until a web UI project uses the kit; package name unverified

tools.name: context7
tools.reason: Up-to-date library docs for the agent

tools.name: lint-hook
tools.reason: Always-on lint check, proposed as a first default check

rubric.problem_fit: Catches style and simple bugs early
rubric.overlap: Project linters differ by stack; needs a per-type choice
rubric.context_cost: None if run as a hook

verdicts.rationale: Which linter depends on project type; decide when the first typed project uses the starter
